name: FinGrowth synthetic lending workspace
description: Hypothetical growth-engineering workspace built from invented aggregate first-loan cohorts. Planning cards are examples, not live experiments or delivered work.

provenance.cohort_definition: Synthetic January 2026 acquisition cohorts; nested unique people with one first loan. Observation cutoff is 2026-10-31. Full repayment precedes repeat in this simplified model; additional repeat-loan exposures are excluded. Maturity is supplied metadata, not verified from schedules.

experiments.title: Hypothetical: clearer document guidance
experiments.primary_metric: KYC completion within seven days / all assigned eligible people (ITT)
experiments.hypothesis: Clearer upload instructions may improve completion without changing underwriting.
guardrails: Fraud/loss thresholds and maturity horizon unresolved
Baseline, MDE, power and eligible assignment traffic unresolved
experiments.next_action: Agree definitions, thresholds and power before seeking human launch approval.

experiments.title: Hypothetical: acquisition-quality investigation
experiments.primary_metric: Mature contribution per assigned eligible person; design unresolved
experiments.hypothesis: Differences in risk mix, attribution or measurement may explain the cheap cohort loss gap.
guardrails: No causal channel claim from descriptive cohorts
No scale decision from funded CAC alone
Do not change underwriting to improve approval conversion
experiments.next_action: Reconcile attribution, risk mix and loss basis before designing a test.

experiments.title: Hypothetical: eligible repeat journey
experiments.primary_metric: Eligible repeat borrowers / fixed eligible repayment cohort within a declared window
experiments.hypothesis: A supported repeat journey may improve eligible return; evidence is not supplied.
guardrails: Eligibility, consent and consumer-treatment review unresolved
Repeat-loan exposures require a separate economics bridge
No customer messaging is authorized by this card
experiments.next_action: Define eligibility and observation window; resolve policy before considering an intervention.

initiatives.title: Hypothetical: ledger-confirmed funding projection
initiatives.acceptance: Proposed: duplicate callbacks and timeout-after-acceptance count one ledger-confirmed first-funded person; repeat reconciliation is stable.
initiatives.dependency: Confirm ledger semantics, stable joins, event ownership and provider idempotency.

initiatives.title: Hypothetical: KYC reason accounting
initiatives.acceptance: Proposed: technical failure, policy rejection, pending work and abandonment reconcile without double-counting retries.
initiatives.dependency: Approve cohort definitions and aggregate reason taxonomy.

initiatives.title: Hypothetical: persistent experiment assignment
initiatives.acceptance: Proposed: person-level assignment persists across devices; ITT outcome query reconciles to all assigned eligible people.
initiatives.dependency: Stable authorized identity, power plan, approved guardrails and rollback owner.
